name: Hyperdrive Router unrestricted CALL action abuses user operator approvals
summary: RouterUpgradeable.execute dispatches CALL actions (kind 15) through RouterLib.call to any AddressRegistry-resolved target with caller-supplied calldata, without binding the call to the caller's own account. Users make the Router their market operator and share/WHYPE spender, so any caller could make the Router invoke market.withdrawCollateral, market.borrow or transferFrom naming another user, stealing collateral, borrowing against victims' positions and sweeping approved balances.
notes: The last pre-exploit Upgraded event on the Router proxy selected RouterUpgradeable 1.1.0 implementation 0x8c3c47cd with the unrestricted CALL action; the EIP-1967 slot holds it from this block through the whole campaign.

Gross victim depletion over three merged campaigns of the same Router CALL defect against implementation 0x8c3c47cd: (A) 2025-09-18 by 0x11181b7d via 0xe253c916, withdrawing zero-debt users' collateral from markets 1 and 2 (unreported publicly); (B) 2025-09-27 by 0x9bb54e91, borrowing 672,934 USDT0 against victims' positions in market 3 and withdrawing 110,244.895039 thBILL collateral from market 7 (the publicly reported ~$782k); (C) 2025-09-27 by MEV EOA 0x0000000000004f3d8a, borrowing 42,700.736036 USDT0 in market 3 and sweeping users' approved WHYPE and market shares. Components are priced with DefiLlama at each campaign's first leg; share components carry unit prices derived from convertToAssets at block-1 of each sweep tx times the underlying price. Hyperdrive's later compensation and its reclaim of campaign-C shares do not reduce gross loss. Tiny UBTC (3 base units) and PT-kHYPE collateral are included at DefiLlama prices.

The publicly reported incident (CertiK source-8, The Block source-21; ~$782k, 2025-09-27) is campaign B. The same defect had already been exploited on 2025-09-18 (source-1), nine days earlier, so the record anchors there; campaign A and the copycat campaign C are merged as later/earlier actors against the same implementation. Router was upgraded to 0x0eada264 at block 14987447 and to 0x03e65321 (CALL/SWAP disabled) at 15039419.
